mechanism: no real object is registered -> the perception layer publishes no B for the demo objects -> the task layer cannot fetch B
declared_mechanism_deviation: TASKS.md says 'registry missing'. Measured 2026-11-16: an empty tracked_objects list (params file or CLI) raises ParameterUninitializedException, so the node dies instead of running without a registry. The realization therefore registers a name the world does not contain, which leaves the node running and no real object observed. The difference is visible to the repairer and is recorded rather than glossed.
expected_observable: observe_server has an empty tracked list, so no object state is published for the demo objects
